details: Exact asserts on byte/token length=12, all IDs>=8, roundtrip=text, fixed chunks, variable chunks and lengths all passed.
result: All exact assertions passed. These counts verify the teaching example only; no throughput, model calls, gradients or model quality were measured.
stdin_verification_excerpt:
import hashlib,json,platform
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from tiny_perceptron.data import ByteTokenizer,SPECIALS
text='catcatdogdog'
raw=text.encode('utf-8')
tok=ByteTokenizer();ids=tok.encode(text)
fixed=[text[i:i+4] for i in range(0,len(text),4)]
variable=[text[:3],text[3:9],text[9:]]
assert len(text)==len(raw)==len(ids)==12
assert all(i>=len(SPECIALS) for i in ids)
assert tok.decode(ids)==text
assert fixed==['catc','atdo','gdog']
assert variable==['cat','catdog','dog']
assert list(map(len,variable))==[3,6,3]
